tldr: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, and its API price is half the price of GPT-5.6 Terra. Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro is live, and its open model files are due on November 4. A new Hermes Agent plugin lets each helper agent run on a different model. Anthropic says Claude will never show ads, in a letter filed with its stock market listing.

articles.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra in ChatGPT and the API
articles.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra rolls out to paid ChatGPT plans and is in the API as gpt-6.1-terra. OpenAI says its standard API price is 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra.

articles.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro with 1M-token context
articles.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model: 2.8T total and 104B active parameters. Open weights are promised by November 4, 2026.

articles.title: Hermes Agent gets an Advanced Delegation plugin
articles.summary: The orchestrator can assign a different model or profile to each subagent, using routes the user sets up. Docs are on the Hermes Agent site.

articles.title: GPT-6.1 Terra now selectable in Hermes Agent
articles.summary: Teknium says GPT-6.1 Terra is available in Hermes Agent through Nous Portal and OpenRouter.

articles.title: Teknium: cloud Hermes instances and apps due within days
articles.summary: Teknium says every subscription gets a cloud Hermes Agent instance, with mobile and desktop apps able to connect. Timing is stated as days, not confirmed.

articles.title: Teknium: try early cloud features on the 'main' release channel
articles.summary: Switching Hermes Agent from the 'stable' to the 'main' release channel gives early access to the cloud and app features.

articles.title: China's new AI and employment policy backs open source and agent apps
articles.summary: The policy supports open-source AI research, AI startups and agent apps, and enterprise adoption. It also assesses job losses and expands AI skills training.

articles.title: HiSTEVE: AI agents that play open-world games through a human interface
articles.summary: A vision-language-action agent that plays open-world games using the same interface a human uses. Paper only; no code confirmed in the post.

articles.title: On-Policy Self-Training: LLM self-improvement without curated data
articles.summary: The paper claims language models can improve themselves without curated training data. This is a paper claim and has not been independently verified.

articles.title: Debunking Cohere's claim about Qwen 3.8 Flash Next uploading to an Alibaba URL
articles.summary: A LocalLLaMA post disputes Cohere's claim that Qwen 3.8 Flash Next tried to send a file to a remote URL. It links to published traces.

articles.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.1-flash-1019 on Hugging Face
articles.summary: inclusionAI's upgraded Ling-3.1-flash: 560B total and 25B active parameters per token, with a 1M-token context window.

articles.title: OpenAI's partner content reaches ChatGPT pre-summarized, the rest gets raw scraps
articles.summary: Content from OpenAI's licensing partners appears to reach ChatGPT through a dedicated pipeline that gives it priority over other web content.

articles.title: Anthropic renews its pledge that Claude will never show ads
articles.summary: In a cover letter with its IPO filing, Anthropic says the chatbot's only incentive should be to give helpful answers, with no ads.

articles.title: OpenAI's Ted Sanders on picking the right GPT model
articles.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra beats the larger Astra at technical communication and costs far less, but trails it in most other areas, per Sanders.
